item.title: Hello World
item.description: This article is to talk about my recent situation. I will be busy preparing for my certificates and licenses before June and will have no time to update my blog. After I am done with that, I will slowly update articles about SITCON 2025 and DEVCORE CONFERENCE 2025 when I have time. Also, when I was working on this blog, I somehow made it dual-language. Although it takes some time to update, it looks pretty good (right?
